Callout.Name: Bike Theft in Progress
Callout.Message: People cutting locks off bicycles at a rack.
Callout.Advisory: Two of them with bolt croppers, several bikes.

Script.Line: I sell bikes. Buying and selling, that is all this is.
The croppers are for the lock. They are not for anything else.
Nothing here is stolen. Not one of them. Check the frames.

Lines.Approach: Two of them at the rack with croppers and they have already had two.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
